findings.title: Remote sample clocks must be replaced at the actual Gateway
findings.mechanism: The source deliberately uses sampleTimeMs=1.0; ready, advancing periodic and command frames must fall between actual Gateway monotonic readings
findings.proposal: Retain common decoder and declared sampleTimeClock defaults

findings.title: One real 16 MiB TLS write did not establish writer-deadline closure
findings.mechanism: The old input timeout could explain a false green. Moving it beyond the observation, constraining reader/OS buffers and using an actual synchronous peer still did not prove the deadline cause
findings.proposal: Retain separate full TLS capacity/peer-loss proof and controlled-drain deadline red/green; make no actual-16MiB writer-timeout claim

findings.title: Server shutdown must release active peers before waiting for server closure
findings.mechanism: Python 3.13 wait_closed waited for active connections while handlers had not been cancelled
findings.proposal: Retain listener-close then peer/source cleanup then wait_closed order

findings.title: A read-only query deadline must preserve the authoritative source
findings.mechanism: A typed query_timeout maps to existing HTTP504; later public periodic frames and a successful pause prove the source remains live
findings.proposal: Keep query errors distinct from uncertain command/transport failures

findings.title: Remote duplicate whitelist rejected publicly registered stress scenes
findings.mechanism: GET/scenes advertised stress100 but POST through TLS returned503; lazy shared SCENES combinations remove the drift while unknown scenes remain rejected
findings.proposal: Keep the single registered scene/source whitelist

findings.title: Client query deadline incorrectly failed the authoritative source
findings.mechanism: Client.04s < querydelay.12s < host.5s returnedHTTP504 plusFAILED; only the host typed timeout path had been nonfatal
findings.proposal: Preserve readers for joint/mesh local deadlines; drain expired reply token, while command/close timeout policy stays fatal
